categories.name: dependency-coupling
categories.definition: Module, build, lint, or configuration state that resolves, compiles, or declares the in-tree Cursor connector or its npm packages. Removing it changes what the host builds or resolves, not what it asserts.

categories.name: tooling-coupling
categories.definition: CI lanes, cache lanes, Makefile targets, helper scripts, and entry points whose behaviour is keyed to Cursor source paths or to invoking Node/npm. Removal changes how the host is verified and run.

categories.name: policy-fixture
categories.definition: Host-owned inventories, absence guards, and policy regressions that name cursorsdk. The name is a data value in a generic host rule; removal requires substituting or retiring the entry while keeping the generic invariant meaningful.

categories.name: contract-fixture
categories.definition: Captured SDK and protocol evidence (sanitized model inventories, frame sequences, invalid-frame corpora, setting-source records) that exists to prove provider and stream semantics. Removal requires the same evidence to exist externally first.

categories.name: active-documentation
categories.definition: Live operator or contributor documentation that currently instructs readers to build, install, or verify Cursor support in this repository. It must be repointed at the standalone plugin rather than deleted.

categories.name: historical-documentation
categories.definition: Provenance that records what the integration used to be: archived specifications, ADRs, and steering. It is retained unchanged as migration evidence and is explicitly not an executable dependency.
